prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, cinematic shot of a sleek, modern laptop partially visible on a dark wooden desk, with a smartphone placed on top of it at an angle. The phone’s screen is illuminated, displaying a mesmerizing, swirling galaxy or nebula with glowing blue, white, and gold cosmic energy, creating a sense of otherworldly motion and depth. The lighting is moody and atmospheric, with soft, diffused natural light coming from the right, casting gentle shadows and highlighting the metallic texture of the laptop and the grain of the wood. The color palette is cool and subdued, dominated by grays, blacks, and deep browns, contrasted by the vibrant, ethereal colors on the phone’s display. The composition is intimate and focused, with a shallow depth of field that blurs the background, drawing attention to the luminous, almost magical quality of the phone’s screen. The overall style is reminiscent of a high-end sci-fi film, evoking a sense of mystery, technology, and cosmic wonder.
